d: Busted for drug smuggling, life in a Mexico jail becomes a living hell for Dwight Yorker, who winds up dressing as a woman in an audacious bid for freedom.
A reckless narcotics agent sets out in pursuit of a Mexican cartel leader, but finds himself sucked into a world where the line between good and evil becomes blurred.
An exotic dancer swaps the club scene of Florida for the dangerous Peruvian cocaine underworld.
U.S. Naval Officer Lamar Burton tries to survive in one of Colombia's most brutal prisons.
In July 2008, Australian photojournalist Nigel Brennan and Canadian reporter Amanda Lindhout ended up spending over a year in captivity while reporting on the war in Somalia.
Andrea wants to prove herself by succeeding in the chauvinistic drug-world.
Former soldier Brett turns to smuggling drugs in India after battling PTSD.
Scottish chef Gordon Malloch moves to Saudi Arabia to start a new life as a catering manager, but soon becomes a popular bootlegger and whiskey smuggler.
